name: Tell Aswad barley with domestication traits
description: Tell Aswad barley remains include a substantial proportion of non-shattering forms, a trait associated with domestication.

date.label: Approximately 10,200–9500 cal BP (8250–7550 BCE)
date.basis: Approximate archaeological context; calibrated BP values use 1950 as reference.

events.statement: Tell Aswad barley remains include a substantial proportion of non-shattering forms, a trait associated with domestication.

evidence.supports: The review reports about 35% non-shattering barley in levels dated to 10,200–9500 cal BP.

events.caveats: The date applies to archaeological levels and does not date the onset or location of barley domestication; identification criteria and earlier dates are debated.
